title: Physiotherapist
description:
**Medicheck Hospital in Haryana**

Medicheck Group of Hospitals is a trusted network dedicated to delivering advanced, ethical, and compassionate healthcare across Haryana. With a strong focus on clinical excellence and patient well\-being, Medicheck combines modern technology with the expertise of experienced medical professionals.

The network includes the Medicheck Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS), Palwal, offering comprehensive multi\-speciality services; Medicheck Hospital, NIT\-1 Faridabad, known for dependable and family\-focused care; and the Medicheck Ortho Superspeciality Hospital, Sector\-46 Faridabad, providing advanced orthopaedic and joint care. Together, these centres reflect Medicheck's mission to make quality healthcare accessible and patient\-friendly.

**About Us**

Medicheck Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS Hospital), is a trusted Palwal’s first 300\-bedded multispeciality hospital in Palwal, offering advanced consultations, expert diagnosis, and comprehensive OPD care across multiple super\-specialities.We aim to bring tertiary\-level healthcare expertise closer to the people of Palwal through compassionate, accessible, and advanced medical care.

From joint pain, back pain, asthma, hypertension, and kidney disorders to complex treatments and surgeries for the heart, brain, spine, knee, and more, patients can now access advanced care from some of Delhi NCR’s leading super\-specialist doctors, closer to home.

Job Description: Physiotherapist

**Physiotherapist**

Department

Physiotherapy \& Rehabilitation

Qualification

* Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) from a recognized institution.
* Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) is preferred.
* Valid registration with the respective State Physiotherapy Council or other applicable regulatory authority, where required.

Experience

* Minimum 1 year of experience as a Physiotherapist in a hospital, rehabilitation center, or healthcare facility.
* Freshers with relevant clinical internship experience may be considered.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess patients' physical conditions and develop individualized physiotherapy treatment plans.
* Provide physiotherapy interventions for orthopedic, neurological, cardiopulmonary, pediatric, geriatric, and post\-operative patients, as applicable.
* Perform therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, electrotherapy, and other evidence\-based physiotherapy techniques.
* Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans based on clinical outcomes.
* Educate patients and caregivers on home exercise programs, posture correction, mobility, and injury prevention.
* Maintain accurate assessment findings, treatment records, progress notes, and discharge summaries.
* Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive patient care.
* Ensure proper use, maintenance, and safe handling of physiotherapy equipment.
* Follow infection prevention and control practices and comply with hospital safety policies.
* Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and continuing professional education.
* Promote patient safety, confidentiality, and ethical standards in all aspects of care.

Required Skills

* Sound knowledge of anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.
* Ability to assess, diagnose, and manage a wide range of musculoskeletal, neurological, and cardiopulmonary conditions.
* Proficiency in therapeutic exercise techniques, manual therapy, and electrotherapy modalities.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and patient counseling skills.
* Good documentation and clinical decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts as per hospital requirements.
* Availability to provide emergency or weekend rehabilitation services when required.

Reporting To

Head of Physiotherapy / Rehabilitation Manager / Medical Superintendent

Preferred Attributes

* Compassionate and patient\-centered approach.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Commitment to evidence\-based practice, continuous learning, and quality improvement.
* Professional attitude with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.

**Job Description: Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

**Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

Department

Operation Theatre (OT)

Qualification

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Operation Theatre Technology (DOTT/B.Sc. Operation Theatre Technology) or an equivalent recognized qualification.
* Certification in Basic Life Support (BLS) is preferred.

Experience

* Minimum 1 year of experience as an OT Technician in a hospital or surgical center.
* Freshers with relevant clinical training or internship may be considered.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare the operation theatre before surgical procedures by ensuring cleanliness, sterility, and readiness of equipment.
* Arrange and sterilize surgical instruments, drapes, consumables, and other equipment required for surgeries.
* Assist surgeons, anesthetists, and nursing staff during surgical procedures.
* Ensure the proper functioning of OT equipment, including operating tables, suction machines, cautery units, monitors, lights, and anesthesia machines, and promptly report any malfunction.
* Maintain aseptic techniques and comply with infection prevention and control protocols.
* Assist in patient positioning, transfer, and preparation before and after surgery.
* Count surgical instruments, needles, and sponges before, during, and after procedures in coordination with the OT nursing staff.
* Clean, disinfect, and prepare the operation theatre for subsequent procedures.
* Maintain records of OT instruments, equipment, sterilization, and inventory.
* Ensure adequate stock of surgical supplies and communicate replenishment requirements to the appropriate department.
* Handle biomedical waste according to hospital policies and statutory guidelines.
* Support emergency and trauma surgeries as required.
* Participate in OT quality improvement initiatives, safety audits, and continuing education programs.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of operation theatre procedures and sterile techniques.
* Familiarity with surgical instruments and OT equipment.
* Understanding of infection prevention and biomedical waste management.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to emergency situations.
* Good communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to patient safety.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts, including day, evening, night, weekends, and public holidays.
* Availability for emergency and on\-call duties as per hospital requirements.

Reporting To

Operation Theatre In\-charge / Nursing Superintendent / OT Manager

Preferred Attributes

* Professional attitude and ethical conduct.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary surgical team.
* Strong time management and problem\-solving skills.
* Commitment to maintaining high standards of patient safety, infection control, and quality care.

description:

**Company:** Radiant Innovative Manufacturing Limited  
**Location:** Mambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu – 602105  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Automotive Manufacturing / Plastic Injection Moulding

About the Company

Radiant Innovative Manufacturing Limited is a leading automotive component manufacturer specializing in plastic injection moulding, precision engineering, and tool manufacturing. We are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and building a people\-centric work culture.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive **Assistant Manager – Human Resources** to join our Chennai manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to plant HR operations, statutory compliance, industrial relations, and workforce management in a manufacturing environment.

Job Summary

The Assistant Manager – HR will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations at the plant, ensuring statutory compliance, fostering healthy employee relations, supporting business objectives through effective manpower planning, and maintaining seamless HR administration.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations for the manufacturing plant.
* Handle Industrial Relations (IR) activities and maintain a healthy employee\-employer relationship.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws, statutory regulations, and factory compliance requirements.
* Coordinate manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, and workforce deployment.
* Address employee grievances and implement effective employee engagement initiatives.
* Maintain employee records, HR documentation, and personnel files.
* Prepare HR MIS reports, attendance, leave records, and other HR analytics.
* Coordinate with government authorities for statutory inspections and documentation.
* Support performance management, disciplinary actions, and policy implementation.
* Conduct employee induction, training coordination, and HR awareness programs.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.

Experience

* 8–12 years of relevant HR experience.
* Experience in Automotive Manufacturing, Plastic Injection Moulding, or other manufacturing industries is mandatory.
* Prior experience in plant HR operations is essential.

Required Skills

* Industrial Relations (IR)
* Statutory Compliance

* Labor Law Knowledge
* Manpower Planning
* Employee Relations
* HR Operations

* HR Documentation

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

* Ability to manage employee relations independently.
* Excellent problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Capable of working in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

description:
**Location: Kanakapura Main Road, Bangalore**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a creative and highly organized **Video Production Manager** to lead the end\-to\-end production of compelling video content that reflects the organization's vision, programs, and global initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in both **script writing** and video production, who can transform ideas into engaging visual stories across digital and offline platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the complete video production lifecycle—from concept development and script writing to shooting, editing, post\-production, and final delivery.
* Develop creative concepts and write scripts for promotional videos, documentaries, interviews, event highlights, educational content, and social media campaigns.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, subject matter experts, marketing teams, and creative professionals to produce high\-quality video content.
* Plan and oversee production schedules, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Coordinate with videographers, editors, graphic designers, voice\-over artists, photographers, and external production agencies when required.
* Direct video shoots, ensuring high production standards in framing, lighting, sound, and storytelling.
* Review edits and provide creative feedback to ensure brand consistency and content quality.
* Create platform\-specific content optimized for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other digital channels.
* Build and maintain a content calendar aligned with organizational campaigns, events, and communication priorities.
* Maintain and organize video assets, footage libraries, and production documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging video production techniques, storytelling formats, and digital content trends.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Film Production, Media Studies, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of professional experience in script writing and video production.
* Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end video production projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing scripted videos, documentaries, promotional films, interviews, or digital campaigns.
* Excellent storytelling, script writing, and visual communication skills.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Skills:**

* Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
* Working knowledge of Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and motion graphics tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of cinematography, lighting, audio recording, and post\-production workflows.
* Familiarity with digital marketing, social media content strategies, and video analytics.
* Experience working with creative agencies, production houses, or media organizations is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). * Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.

* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines

* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.

* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.

* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.

description:

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

You will learn the complete sports manufacturing ecosystem while helping create professional HR systems, recruitment processes, company policies, training manuals, and documentation that will support BAT MASTER's future expansion.

* Cricket equipment manufacturing
* Sports retail market
* Dealers and distributors
* Cricket academies
* Sports brands and competitors
* Private\-label manufacturing
* Market trends and customer expectations

Prepare research reports that support business decisions.

Documentation \& Process Improvement

* Create process documents.
* Develop training presentations.
* Maintain HR documentation.
* Recommend improvements in HR and operational systems.

Skills Required

* Excellent written and spoken English
* Strong research and analytical skills
* Documentation and report writing

* Google Workspace
* Attention to detail

description:
**Intern: Procurement \& Resource Development**

**Place of Posting: Purnea, BIhar**

**About Company:**

AgroKisan, a brand owned by Krishi Samriddhi Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative Agritech startups, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize agriculture in India. AgroKisan focus on precision farming, agriculture value chain, and sustainable solutions for efficiency and resilience in agricultural sector. With a commitment to modernizing practices, AgroKisan play a vital role in shaping a more sustainable and productive future for Indian Agriculture Ecosystem. We are supported by Govt. of Bihar and incubated under Indian Institute of Technology, Patna.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Intern to join our Agribusiness team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various aspects of agricultural industry. This role offers exposure to a fast\-paced and innovative environment where you will work closely with our sales and marketing professionals to support our business objectives.

**Role Overview**

The Intern – Procurement (Agri Commodity) \& Resource Development will be responsible for sourcing agricultural commodities, managing field\-level procurement operations, and developing a strong network of farmers, FPOs, vendors, and field resources. The role ensures high\-quality, cost\-effective procurement while building sustainable relationships across the agriculture value chain. It also involves developing and training field partners, enabling efficient supply aggregation, and strengthening resource planning for ongoing agritech operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agri Commodity Procurement**

* Identify and onboard farmers, FPOs/FPCs, aggregators, and traders for commodity sourcing.
* Conduct market research to track commodity prices, demand patterns, and seasonal availability.
* Negotiate procurement terms, quality parameters, and logistics with suppliers.
* Ensure timely procurement of commodities such as fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, pulses, or any crop aligned with company operations.
* Coordinate quality checks during procurement and ensure adherence to grading and standard specifications.
* Support contract farming or buy\-back arrangements with growers where applicable.

**2\. Field Resource Development \& Network Expansion**

* Develop a robust field network including farmers, FPOs, community leaders, agri\-input dealers, and rural micro\-entrepreneurs.
* Train and support field partners on procurement processes, quality parameters, and digital reporting tools.
* Conduct field visits to assess crop readiness, farmer engagement, and resource availability.
* Build a database of field resources to support sourcing, aggregation, and logistics operations.
* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.
* Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure a seamless procurement\-to\-delivery pipeline.
* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.
* Ensure minimal wastage, efficient handling, and cost\-effective aggregation.

**4\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, farmers, FPO leaders, and local market stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic supplier evaluations based on quality, reliability, and pricing.
* Resolve field\-level issues related to quality disputes, procurement delays, or logistics challenges.
* Collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, or agri institutions for field\-level resource development.

**5\. Resource Planning, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of procurement volumes, sourcing locations, farmer databases, vendor details, and field activities.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on procurement performance, price trends, and field resource development.
* Ensure documentation compliance including purchase orders, agreements, receipts, and quality reports.
* Use digital tools or ERP systems to log procurement and field data accurately.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred.

**Work Experience**

* Freshers can also apply
* Prior experience in agri commodity procurement, field sourcing, supply chain, or rural operations will be prefered.
* Experience working with farmers, FPOs, mandi operations, rural networks, or agritech companies is highly desirable.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of agri commodities, market dynamics, crop cycles, and quality standards.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and vendor management skills.
* Ability to build rapport with farmers and rural stakeholders.
* Knowledge of mandi operations, auction systems, and procurement compliance.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, procurement tools, and mobile\-based field reporting apps.
* Willingness to travel extensively to sourcing clusters.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Field\-focused attitude with problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with empathy toward farmers and rural communities.
* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.
* Ability to handle pressure and dynamic procurement requirements.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging agritech business models.
* Career growth in procurement, rural operations, and supplier development.
* Direct impact on farmer livelihoods and sustainable sourcing.

Interested Candidate may send thier cv at hr@agrokisan.com

description:
HR Services Department India, Chennai, India
   

  

 Our Graduate Programme in Chennai, India offers a unique opportunity to begin your professional journey while gaining practical experience in a collaborative and fast\-paced HR environment. If you've just completed your degree and are eager to develop your skills and build a strong foundation for your career, our Graduate Programme is the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

 We offer our graduates rewarding career opportunities within our HR Services team, where they can learn, grow, and contribute to a performance\-driven culture. The Graduate Programme provides graduates with the opportunity to gain exposure to key HR processes and support functions, helping them build a solid understanding of HR operations and shared services.
   

  

 Working alongside experienced professionals, graduates will develop practical skills while taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to day\-to\-day HR operations. Additionally, participants will have access to training programmes covering essential HR processes, business communication, professional etiquette, collaboration, and other core workplace skills.
   

  

 All graduates will be assigned mentors who will guide them throughout their development journey at Glencore. The mentoring programme will help new joiners understand our company culture, develop professionally, and build relationships across the HR Services team.
   

  

**Global HR Hub \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme**
 We are seeking a detail\-orientated, proactive, and highly motivated Graduate to be part of the Global HR Services team in Chennai, India, through the HR Hub which supports key operational processes for multiple Glencore offices worldwide.
   

  

 Global HR \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme is designed to prove your aptitude and test your resilience providing functional support to HR Services and Payroll, with opportunities to rotate between.
   

  

 The HR graduate will work in a shared service centre environment (our HR Hub) and the required attributes include strong organizational skills, a customer\-focused mindset, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, globally matrixed environment and gain exposure to international HR operations and best practice and contribute to impactful employee experiences across the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in or have recently graduated with a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related study is beneficial.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.
   

  

 With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
Overview:

The Senior Implementation Consultant is a trusted advisor responsible for leading customers through the successful implementation, configuration, and early adoption of iCIMS solutions. This role partners closely with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, provide strategic consultation, recommend best practices, and ensure successful deployment aligned with organizational hiring goals.


As a senior individual contributor, the consultant leads complex customer engagements, mentors team members, resolves implementation challenges, and drives successful project outcomes while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.


About Us:

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end\-to\-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.  

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise\-grade hiring technology, AI\-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.
Responsibilities:
**Customer Consulting \& Solution Design**

* Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business processes, requirements, and goals.
* Recommend solution designs and configuration strategies that align with iCIMS best practices.
* Guide customers through process optimization and change management considerations.

**Project Delivery \& Implementation Leadership**

* Lead complex implementation engagements from project kick\-off through go live.
* Drive requirements gathering, solution design validation, configuration reviews, testing, training, and deployment activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks while proactively developing mitigation plans.
* Ensure projects remain aligned to scope, timelines, and customer expectations.

**Solution Configuration \& Product Expertise**

* Configure and optimize iCIMS products to support customer requirements.
* Act as a product subject matter expert across assigned solution areas.
* Validate system readiness and support user acceptance testing activities.
* Troubleshoot complex configuration and process\-related issues.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships with project sponsors, business stakeholders, and system administrators.
* Act as the primary implementation consultant and strategic partner for customers.
* Provide ongoing consultation and recommendations to maximize platform value.
* Translate complex technical concepts into business\-friendly language.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Project Managers, Integration Consultants, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and other internal teams.
* Coordinate resources and activities required for successful project delivery.
* Support escalations and facilitate resolution of customer concerns.
* Contribute to seamless transitions during go\-live and post\-implementation handoffs.

**Mentorship \& Continuous Improvement**

* Mentor and coach Implementation Consultants and Associate Consultants.
* Share best practices, implementation methodologies, and customer success strategies.
* Contribute to process improvements, documentation standards, playbooks, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Participate in strategic initiatives that improve delivery quality and operational efficiency.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree with equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, consulting, professional services, HR technology, or enterprise software deployment.
* Experience leading customer\-facing projects and managing multiple priorities.
* Strong consultative, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience facilitating customer workshops, discovery sessions, and executive discussions.
* Could have successfully delivered end\-to\-end implementation preferably in HR Tech SaaS or in any other SaaS products.
* Ability to work in a fixed hybrid model and support late EMEA working hours.


Preferred:
* Experience with HR Technology, Talent Acquisition, HCM, ATS, CRM, or onboarding platforms.
* Project management experience is a plus.
* Experience working in global and cross\-functional environments.
* Knowledge of integration concepts, and HR tech enterprise business processes is a plus.

Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. title: Group Human Resources Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and dependable Human Resources Manager to oversee the complete employee lifecycle, with a strong focus on recruitment, employee performance, disciplinary matters, and terminations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for hiring qualified employees, supporting management with staffing decisions, handling sensitive workplace matters professionally, and ensuring all HR actions comply with applicable employment laws and company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage the complete recruitment process, including creating job postings, screening applications, conducting interviews, checking references, and preparing employment offers.
* Work with management to identify staffing requirements and hire suitable candidates for office, sales, warehouse, and operational positions.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, orientation, employment documentation, and probationary\-period reviews.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, contracts, attendance information, warnings, and performance documentation.
* Develop and maintain workplace policies, employee handbooks, job descriptions, and HR procedures.
* Monitor employee attendance, conduct, productivity, and workplace performance.
* Support managers in addressing performance concerns, employee complaints, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters.
* Prepare written warnings, performance improvement plans, and other disciplinary documentation.
* Manage employee terminations professionally, including documentation, termination meetings, final\-pay coordination, and return of company property.
* Ensure hiring, discipline, layoffs, and terminations comply with applicable employment standards, human rights requirements, and company policies.
* Conduct workplace investigations and document findings when necessary.
* Assist with compensation reviews, vacation tracking, benefits administration, payroll information, and employee leave requests.
* Promote a respectful, productive, and professional workplace culture.

Qualifications:

* Diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience in an HR Manager, HR Generalist, or similar position.
* Strong experience with recruitment, employee relations, performance management, discipline, and termination procedures.
* Good understanding of applicable employment laws and workplace regulations.
* Excellent communication, interviewing, conflict\-resolution, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable making difficult and fair employment decisions when required.

The ideal candidate will be confident, organized, fair, and capable of managing sensitive employee matters independently while protecting both the company and its employees.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Junior HR Associate
description:
**About Us:**


**Fresh Prints** is a New York\-based custom apparel startup. We work with talented student entrepreneurs and provide the working capital, training, and support they need to build businesses at their schools.



At most companies, recruiting is about filling open roles. At Fresh Prints, recruiting is about building the teams that determine where the company goes next. Every hire shapes how fast we grow, how well our teams perform, and what we're capable of building. That's why we don't see Talent Acquisition as a support function. We see it as a strategic capability that directly influences the business.



This role goes far beyond posting jobs and coordinating interviews. We're looking for someone who enjoys building pipelines before they're needed, questioning existing processes, and finding smarter ways to help great people discover Fresh Prints.


**Role Overview**



As a Jr. HR Associate at Fresh Prints, you will support talent acquisition efforts across multiple roles. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to help deliver a seamless hiring experience from sourcing through hiring. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, highly organized, and eager to build a career in recruitment and people operations.


**Key Responsibilities**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines.
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar.
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role.
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines.
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates.
* Develop search strategies to identify and attract top talent.
* Take ownership of recruitment\-related projects and additional responsibilities as needed.


**Requirements**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Fresh graduates of Human Resources or Psychology are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Strong internship experience in HR or Recruitment is highly preferred.
* Experience in a startup environment or in\-house recruitment is a plus.
* Experience working in a remote environment is preferred.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* **Monthly Salary:** Between $400 to $550, with a night allowance of $40

**Location \& Timings**


* **Full\-time remote** role starting as soon as the right candidate is found.
* **Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Fabhotels  

Industry: Hospitality
Seniority level: Associate level  



Experience: 3\+ yrs



Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India



Job Type: Full\-time



**About the role**
------------------


* Manage the full recruitment life cycle sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates across levels and functions \- Non IT Hiring
* Partner with hiring managers and business heads to understand role requirements, organizational structure, and business priorities.
* Build effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and networking.
* Drive proactive talent mapping and pipeline building for critical and niche roles.
* Ensure a strong employer brand presence through social media and candidate engagement initiatives.
* Conduct HR discussions, negotiate offers, and ensure seamless onboarding coordination.
* Maintain and update recruitment dashboards, metrics, and reports for leadership visibility.
* Manage vendor relationships (if applicable) and ensure adherence to hiring budgets and timelines.
* Champion diversity hiring and inclusion initiatives across all business functions.
  


Required Skills \& Qualifications:


* 3\-5 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment (corporate or agency background).
* Proven success in hiring for mid to senior\-level roles across business, tech, or support functions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, ATS systems, etc.).
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to track, analyze, and report key hiring metrics.
* Self\-driven, high ownership, and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Leveraged AI Tools for Screening and recruitment processes
  


Preferred Qualifications:


* MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent or Ba \- English Hons or Psychology from good college
* Experience in a high\-growth or startup environment will be a strong plus.
  


What We Offer:


* Fast\-paced, merit\-driven environment.
* Exposure to leadership hiring and strategic HR projects.
* Opportunity to shape and scale the organizations talent strategy.
* 5 days work from office
**About the company**
---------------------


FabHotels has built India’s largest tech\-enabled budget hotel network with 1,400\+ properties across 80\+ cities. TravelPlus \- India’s largest player in the corporate travel segment offering a one\-stop solution for all corporate travel needs.
**Must\-have skills**
---------------------


non it recruitment, Recruitment
**Good\-to\-have skills**
-------------------------


Headhunting, Non Technical recruiting, leadership hiring

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Key tasks may involve managing committee rosters, ensuring data accuracy, tracking the completion of PD and/or review\-related documents, sending communications to evaluees and evaluators, and organizing day\-of \-review support. You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.


In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.

The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience is required


1\+ years of professional experience in HR, Talent or Professional development operations


Able to work efficiently and effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment


Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy when handling information and following established processes

Outstanding organizational skills; detail\-oriented; able to prioritize and multitask; strong ownership evident through responsibility and accountability for product; highly proactive mindset


Demonstrates good judgment and knows when to seek guidance


Ability to work in\-person at the Manila or Gurugram Service Center for a minimum of two days a week, with the flexibility to work from other office or non\-office settings and travel to less accessible environments as team schedules or business needs require (excluding legally exempt circumstances)


Strong communication skills in English; both verbal and written

title: S4C - Training coordinator
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**


As a **Training Coordinator**, you will help plan, organise, and deliver training activities as part of our SAP S/4HANA transformation programme. You'll work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), trainers, and business teams to ensure employees have the knowledge and support they need before and after system go\-live.


This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating activities, creating training content, working with different stakeholders, and keeping projects on track.

**About Role**

**Training Coordination**

* Help plan and schedule training activities.
* Organise training sessions across multiple teams and locations.
* Manage training calendars, meeting invites, and logistics.
* Coordinate with trainers, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training runs smoothly.

**Training Content \& Materials**

* Assist in creating and updating training materials, presentations, user guides, and quick reference guides.
* Work with business experts to turn complex processes into easy\-to\-understand training content.
* Ensure training materials are clear, consistent, and up to date.
* Gather feedback from training participants and help improve future sessions.
* Support refresher and follow\-up training after go\-live.

**Tracking \& Reporting**

* Monitor training attendance and completion rates.
* Maintain training trackers and dashboards.
* Provide regular updates on training progress.
* Identify and raise potential issues early, such as low attendance or training gaps.
* Support user readiness activities with training data and insights.

**Stakeholder Support**

* Work closely with the Organizational Change Management (OCM) team to understand training needs.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and expectations to different audiences.
* Help ensure employees are ready and confident to use new SAP processes and systems.
**IMPORTANT: WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

*This is not a leadership or management position. We are not looking for an OCM Lead, Manager, or someone whose experience is primarily in strategy, governance, or team management. This role is focused on execution and coordination. We’re looking for someone who can manage training schedules, support content creation, ensure sessions run smoothly, and keep the programme on track.*

***NOTE:*** *Supporting EU/US timezones: flexibility around work hours is to be expected*

**About you**

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Experience supporting or coordinating training activities on an SAP S/4HANA project.
* Experience using **SAP Enable Now** to create or maintain training materials.
* Strong organisational and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams and levels.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience supporting SAP transformation projects in Healthcare, MedTech, or Pharmaceutical organisations.
* Knowledge of role\-based training or train\-the\-trainer approaches.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, HR, or other business process transformation programmes.
* Experience supporting large\-scale system implementations.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


People Analytics \& Insights (PAI) team is part of Human Resource Department. This team is equipped to assist our clients with quick insights, dashboards, reporting resources and guides that will help deliver actionable insights and transform how the firm leverages human capital data which in turn helps in data driven decision making.


Reporting Solutions Analyst role is primarily focused on reporting and data management. This role is part of Reporting Solutions which is an integral part of People Analytics \& Insights team. Role will require specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Interpreting data and making recommendations. Identifying inconsistencies in data or results, defining business issues and formulate recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Role demands to have good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area.


Responsibilities:


* This function covers incumbents responsible for various data activities, which includes data analysis, maintenance, data quality, and database management.
* Develop, Maintain, and Deliver recurring and ad\-hoc reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timelines.
* Following Internal Processes like following SOPs for report preparation, updating internal trackers, following maker checker process etc.
* Partnering internally within PAI team members to understand reporting needs and provide effective data solutions.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Handling sensitive data with the highest level of care, ensuring strict adherence to processes, data privacy standards, and organizational guidelines when sharing information with clients and stakeholders.
* Performing Dashboard Validations in Tableau and collaborating with PAI Data Science team to validate and test HR dashboards for accuracy, usability and business relevance.
* Focusing on continuous improvement and proactively identifying opportunities to streamline reporting processes, enhance data visualization and improve the overall reporting experience
* Creating and Maintaining clear documentation for reporting processes, methodologies, and data definitions to ensure consistency and transparency.
* Equipping yourself with a thorough understanding of existing tableau dashboards/ products to effectively interpret, validate and enhance reporting solutions.

  

Qualifications:


* Min 3 – 5 years of experience in handling data in a corporate environment, HR Data \& Reporting experience is a plus.
* Intermediate expertise in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel (formulas, pivot, tables, data analysis, conditional formatting etc.) \& PowerPoint (presentation building).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey data insights clearly.
* Working knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) tools ( e.g. – Tableau) or SharePoint site is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
* A proactive, “go\-to” attitude with the ability to take initiative and work independently.

Education:


* Min Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

**Who we are looking for**

A Payroll \& HR Operations professional that has proven experience in working with Luxembourg Payroll \& HR processes and knowledge about regulations including local legislation on the HR Operation and Payroll. Individual contributor with process\-oriented experience, easy adaptation skills, and capability to work in changing environment. Ideal candidate will possess ability to rotate between tasks and processes within the Payroll \& HR Operations organization. This role will consist of liaison between vendors \& internal stakeholders and will be based in India.


**What you will be responsible for**

As part of the Luxembourg Payroll and HR Operations team, your main activities will be:


* Deliver payroll administration activities and coordinate related activities with Payroll Provider and Employees and provide support for such HR services.
* Support payroll, statutory reporting and other HR related activities, including maintaining a working relationship with local revenue and governmental agencies *(sickness reporting, medical checks follow up, overtime reporting, etc.)*
* Execute HR administration activities related to Employees’ day\-to\-day life *(maternity leave, parental leave, study leave, part\-time amendment, terminations, etc.)*
* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure timely responses to employee queries via ticketing systems.
* Maintaining the database in relation to the working from home agreements and assisting with the tax and social security obligations
* Ensure that all the data privacy and destruction rules are followed and considered during the HR Administration processes.
* Ensure that you make reasonable decisions by exercising reasonable care when considering information available to you. This includes taking proactive action to ensure that the information you have is suitable and adequate.
* Support other CoE’s ad\-hoc requests whilst maintaining strong working relationships

**Preferred skills and Qualifications**

* Proven experience of 4\-6 years in HR operations and payroll
* Knowledge of Luxembourg payroll and HR regulations
* Fluent English and additional asset French language
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

title: Instructional Designer (Learning & Development)
description:
**Description**
---------------


**About the Role**


As a member of SIDE's Global Player Support organization, the Instructional Designer is responsible for designing, developing, and continuously improving learning solutions that support onboarding, operational readiness, and long\-term service excellence across our global Player Support programs.


Working closely with Learning \& Development, Operations, Quality, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and client stakeholders, you will transform operational knowledge into engaging, learner\-focused experiences that accelerate knowledge acquisition, improve performance, and ensure teams are prepared to deliver exceptional player support.


Every role follows a structured onboarding and development pathway designed to build confidence, strengthen operational knowledge, and prepare individuals for success in a live support environment.  

  



**What You'll Be Doing**


* Design, develop, and maintain engaging learning materials for onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs.
* Create instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, self\-paced, and blended learning content using instructional design best practices.
* Translate complex operational processes, workflows, and product knowledge into clear, learner\-friendly training materials.
* Develop structured learning paths, certification programs, knowledge checks, assessments, and practical learning activities.
* Partner with Operations, Training, Quality, and Subject Matter Experts to gather requirements and ensure learning content reflects current operational processes.
* Support knowledge transfer activities during new client implementations, program transitions, and process changes.
* Continuously review and update learning content based on operational feedback, quality insights, learner performance, and business requirements.
* Maintain version control and governance across learning documentation, job aids, facilitator guides, participant materials, and knowledge repositories.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness through learner feedback, assessment results, and operational performance metrics to recommend improvements.
* Ensure learning content aligns with adult learning principles and supports different learning styles.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance learner engagement, knowledge retention, and operational readiness.
**Requirements**
----------------


**What You'll Bring**


* **2–3 years of experience in an Instructional Designer, Learning Content Developer, or similar Learning \& Development role**.
* **Experience designing learning solutions within Customer Support, Player Support, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Gaming**, or similar operational environments is preferred.
* Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles.
* **Relevant certifications in Instructional Design, eLearning development, or adult learning methodologies** are an advantage.
* Excellent written communication, content writing, and information structuring skills.
* Ability to simplify complex operational concepts into engaging and easy\-to\-understand learning experiences.
* Experience developing instructor\-led, e\-learning, self\-paced, and blended learning programs.
* Experience creating assessments, quizzes, facilitator guides, learner guides, job aids, and knowledge documentation.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Training, Quality, and Program teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, Confluence, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* **Experience using instructional authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond**, or similar platforms is desirable.
* Basic graphic design, multimedia, or video editing skills are an advantage.

**Keys to Success**


* Design engaging learning experiences that improve onboarding quality, operational readiness, and learner confidence.
* Deliver high\-quality learning content that remains accurate, current, and aligned with evolving operational requirements.
* Translate operational expertise into scalable learning solutions that improve knowledge retention and employee performance.
* Build trusted partnerships with Learning, Operations, Quality, and Program stakeholders to ensure learning remains relevant and effective.
* Continuously evaluate and enhance learning materials using learner feedback, quality insights, and operational performance data.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence across the Global Player Support organization.
  

  

**PS****:\- This role involves a rotational shift (including US/Night shift)**


**Benefits**
------------


**What we offer:**


* The opportunity to join our growing business at an exciting time.

Dynamic and entrepreneurial culture.  
* 

**Who we are:**


**Side** is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. **Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30\+ years' experience** from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with **15\+ studios** in **over a dozen countries** across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.
Our industry\-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.


Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences.


For more information, visit www.side.inc.

title: HR Senior Director
description:
The Senior Compensation Tools Analytics Lead is a key member of the Compensation Centre of Excellence (COE), responsible for the strategy, governance, and optimization of compensation systems, tools, data, and analytics. This role combines deep compensation expertise with advanced analytical capabilities to ensure the organization has accurate, reliable, and actionable reward insights.
  
  

The role partners closely with HR Technology, People Analytics, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to deliver compensation reporting, modelling, benchmarking, pay equity analysis, annual compensation processes, and continuous improvements to reward technologies.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Compensation Analytics Insights
  
  

* Develop and maintain compensation dashboards, reports, and analytical models to support business decision\-making.
* Deliver insights on pay positioning, market competitiveness, pay equity, internal equity, and compensation trends.
* Conduct statistical analyses and modelling to support compensation strategy and reward programs.
* Produce executive\-level reporting and presentations for senior leadership and governance committees.
* Develop KPIs and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of compensation programs.


Compensation Tools Technology
  
  

* Serve as the functional lead for compensation systems and technology solutions.
* Partner with HRIS and technology teams to design, implement, test, and optimize compensation modules and processes.
* Manage compensation system configuration, data integrity, security, and governance.
* Drive automation and digitalization initiatives to improve compensation processes and user experience.
* Lead system enhancements, upgrades, and vendor relationships where applicable.


Data Governance Compliance
  
  

* Establish governance standards for compensation data quality and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with pay transparency, equal pay, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop controls and audit processes to maintain data accuracy and integrity.
* Support internal and external audits related to compensation programs.


Key Competencies
  
  

* Compensation Expertise
* Advanced Analytics Data Storytelling
* HR Technology Systems
* Business Acumen
* Data Governance
* Continuous Improvement
* Project Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Communication
* Stakeholder Influence

title: Embedded Software Design Engineer
description:
Embedded Software Design Engineer:

We are looking for a passionate Embedded Software Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to join our software team. You will develop firmware, device drivers, board support packages and application software for our GNSS receivers, time synchronization systems, antenna control units and rugged computing products, working closely with the hardware team from board bring\-up to field deployment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop firmware in Embedded C/C\+\+ for ARM Cortex\-M/Cortex\-A based microcontrollers and SoCs.
* Develop and port Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders (U\-Boot) and device drivers on Embedded Linux and RTOS platforms (FreeRTOS or equivalent).
* Implement drivers and application software for peripherals and interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, RS\-232/422/485 and GPIO.
* Develop and integrate communication protocols including TCP/IP, UDP, NTP/PTP time synchronization and NMEA/GNSS message parsing.
* Support board bring\-up of new hardware — flashing, debugging and validating processor, memory and peripheral functionality along with the hardware team.
* Implement algorithms for navigation, tracking and control applications in coordination with senior engineers.
* Write test code, perform unit and integration testing, and support environmental/EMI qualification test cycles.
* Debug issues at the hardware\-software boundary using JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Prepare software design documents, test reports and user documentation.

**Required Skills:** 

* Strong programming fundamentals in C (and preferably C\+\+), data structures and memory management.
* Good understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architecture, interrupts, timers, DMA and peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Basic knowledge of Embedded Linux or any RTOS concepts (tasks, scheduling, semaphores, queues).
* Familiarity with development tools: GCC toolchains, Makefiles, Git, JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets and work closely with hardware engineers.
* Good analytical, debugging and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): hands\-on project experience in firmware/driver/BSP development is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to GNSS/GPS, navigation, SATCOM or communication systems.
* Knowledge of Linux kernel/device driver development or Yocto build systems.
* Exposure to networking protocols (TCP/IP stack, NTP/PTP) or socket programming.
* Scripting knowledge (Python/Shell) for test automation.
* Familiarity with defense/aerospace software practices and documentation.

**What We Offer:** 

* Hands\-on exposure to complete product development — firmware to field deployment — on mission\-critical defense and aerospace products.
* Mentorship from a core team of experienced professionals across specialized domains.
* Fast learning curve in a DeepTech environment serving leading Indian PSUs and defense organizations.

* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

title: RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (FPGA)
description:
**RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (FPGA) :** 

We are seeking an RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to develop FPGA\-based digital logic for our signal processing, navigation, timing and control products. You will design, simulate, verify and implement RTL for high\-pin\-count FPGAs used in GNSS receivers, beacon receivers, time servers and antenna control systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop RTL modules in Verilog/VHDL for FPGA\-based products — interface controllers, timing logic, data acquisition and signal processing blocks.
* Develop testbenches and perform functional simulation and verification of RTL designs (ModelSim/Vivado Simulator/Questa).
* Perform synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing constraint definition (SDC/XDC) and timing closure on Xilinx/Intel FPGA platforms (Vivado/Quartus).
* Implement and integrate interface logic such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, memory controllers (DDR), Ethernet MAC and high\-speed serial interfaces.
* Integrate and validate soft processor cores (MicroBlaze/NIOS) and IP cores, and support hardware\-software co\-design with the firmware team.
* Support FPGA board bring\-up and hardware validation using ChipScope/ILA, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Develop DSP blocks (filters, correlators, NCOs, mixers) for GNSS/beacon signal processing applications under guidance of senior engineers.
* Document design architecture, verification plans, test reports and release notes.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong fundamentals in digital design — combinational/sequential logic, FSMs, FIFOs, clock domain crossing and pipelining.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of Verilog (or VHDL) coding for synthesis and simulation.
* Familiarity with FPGA design flow: simulation, synthesis, implementation, constraints and timing analysis.
* Exposure to Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus toolchains.
* Understanding of common peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C) and memory basics.
* Ability to write testbenches and debug simulation waveforms.
* Good problem\-solving, analytical and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): project experience in FPGA implementation, timing closure and board\-level validation is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to DSP concepts (FIR/IIR filters, FFT, correlation) or SDR/GNSS signal processing.
* Knowledge of AXI/AVALON bus protocols and SoC FPGA platforms (Zynq).
* Exposure to high\-speed interfaces (PCIe, SerDes, Gigabit Ethernet) or DDR memory controllers.
* Familiarity with SystemVerilog or UVM\-based verification.

**About the Role**

Are you fascinated by Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models? We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and creative fresher to join our growing AI team as a Prompt Engineer. This is a fantastic opportunity to kickstart your career in the AI industry.

Under the mentorship of our senior engineering team, you will learn how to shape the way our AI systems interact, reason, and deliver value. You will assist in designing, testing, and refining the prompts that drive complex LLM behaviors. If you love experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and want to turn that passion into a career building advanced AI\-native products and autonomous workflows, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prompt Design \& Optimization:** Assist in crafting, refining, and iterating on prompts to elicit specific, high\-quality responses from foundational LLMs (e.g., GPT\-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama).

* **Evaluation \& Testing:** Help conduct rigorous A/B testing and use evaluation frameworks to measure prompt effectiveness, accuracy, and response times.
* **Workflow Automation:** Collaborate with AI Solutions Engineers to understand and support automated pipelines where AI agents solve multi\-step problems.
* **Quality \& Safety Assurance:** Review AI outputs to spot "hallucinations," identify edge cases, and ensure responses align with safety and ethical guidelines.
* **Documentation:** Help build and maintain a comprehensive internal library of prompt templates and version control histories.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** Recent graduate (B.Tech/B.E, B.Sc, BCA, or similar) in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Technical Knowledge:** A strong foundational understanding of (or eager willingness to learn) LLM orchestration frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and Agentic RAG architectures.
* **Programming:** Basic proficiency in Python scripting and familiarity with standard data structures (JSON, XML) to interface with APIs.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Deeply logical and detail\-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, reverse\-engineering problems, and figuring out *why* an AI model gave a specific answer.
* **Communication:** Excellent written communication skills, with a nuanced understanding of linguistics, context, and tone.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.

title: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing Facility
description:
**Position: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing FacilityDepartment (Night Shift)**

**Job Summary**

The Quality Control (QC) Executive is responsible for ensuring that all cleaned plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, serving utensils, crates, and other reusable food\-service items meet the company's quality, hygiene, and customer standards before dispatch. The role involves inspecting products at every stage of the washing, drying, sorting, packing, and dispatch process to ensure zero\-defect deliveries and maximum customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Quality Inspection**

* Inspect all washed plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, trays, serving utensils, and containers before packing.
* Ensure items are completely free from:
* Food residue
* Oil and grease
* Water marks
* Stains
* Soap or detergent residue
* Odor
* Dust or contamination
* Reject chipped, cracked, broken, bent, rusted, or damaged items.
* Verify that all items meet company quality standards before approval.

**2\. Dispatch Verification**

* Verify customer\-wise packing quantities before dispatch.
* Ensure correct plate sizes, cutlery types, serving utensils, and accessories are packed according to the dispatch list.
* Cross\-check dispatch against customer orders.
* Prevent shortages, excess quantities, or wrong item dispatches.

**3\. Process Monitoring**

* Monitor washing, rinsing, drying, sorting, and packing activities.
* Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are followed at every stage.
* Conduct random in\-process quality inspections during production.
* Ensure rejected items are not mixed with approved inventory.

**4\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high hygiene standards in washing, drying, inspection, and packing areas.
* Ensure employees follow personal hygiene requirements, including gloves, uniforms, masks, hairnets, and hand\-washing procedures.
* Verify proper storage of cleaned utensils to prevent contamination.
* Report any hygiene or sanitation violations immediately.

**5\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain Daily QC Inspection Reports.
* Record rejection quantities and rejection reasons.
* Prepare Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) reports.
* Maintain customer complaint records.
* Report recurring quality issues to the Operations Manager.

**6\. Continuous Improvement**

* Identify root causes of quality failures.
* Recommend improvements in washing, drying, handling, and packing processes.
* Assist in reducing customer complaints and product rejections.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and internal audits.

Authority

The QC Executive has the authority to:

* Stop dispatch of non\-conforming materials.
* Reject damaged or improperly cleaned utensils.
* Recommend rewash or rework of rejected items.
* Escalate repeated quality issues to management.
* Request corrective actions from Operations or Washing teams.

Required Skills

* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong observation and inspection skills.
* Basic knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety practices.
* Ability to identify quality defects quickly.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

Qualifications

* Minimum: 12th Pass.
* Graduate or Diploma in Hospitality, Food Technology, Quality, or Operations is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in Quality Control, Hospitality, Housekeeping, Laundry, Food Processing, Catering, Warehousing, or Manufacturing.
* Freshers with strong learning ability and discipline may also be considered.

Preferred Qualities

* Responsible and disciplined.
* Honest and dependable.
* Positive attitude.
* High level of integrity.
* Team player.
* Punctual and reliable.
* Ability to maintain consistent quality standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* 100% inspection of all dispatch materials.
* Zero dispatch of dirty or damaged items.
* Reduction in customer quality complaints.
* Reduction in rejected or returned materials.
* 100% compliance with SOPs and hygiene standards.
* Dispatch quantity accuracy above 99\.5%.
* Timely reporting of quality issues.
* Reduction in rewash and rework percentage.
* CAPA closure within defined timelines.

Working Conditions

* Work in a plate washing and sanitation facility.
* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Exposure to wet work areas and cleaning chemicals.
* Rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required.
* Mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
