title: Senior HRIS Analyst
description:
About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product\-passionate community \& enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user\-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever\-expanding retail, social \& search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands \& retailers to gain valuable business insights from real\-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long\-term loyalty.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!  


The Human Resources function is responsible for providing human resources (HR) support to a major business unit or functional area. This includes any issues relating to talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee relations, training and development, and HR operations. The Analytics, Modeling, \& Reporting area is responsible for analyzing and reporting on data sets for a particular area to evaluate, recommend and support the implementation of business strategies and operational processes. The Human Resources Information System (HRIS) and Reporting focus specializes in HRIS and Reporting maintenance and ongoing administration. Oversees the development and implementation of new or redesigned systems, reports, policies, and procedures. Manages relationships with vendors, and the development of training and documentation for system use and maintenance. This job family is in the professional level category and works independently with flexibility and authority over daily work priorities. Incumbents in this job level category may provide work direction to other employees but would not typically have the authority to discipline or reward other employees. There are different levels available that provide clarity on contribution expectations based on knowledge, application, problem solving, and collaboration.  

  

**Job Description:**  

We are looking for a Senior HRIS Analyst to join our global HR Technology team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our Workday ecosystem. You will partner closely with a global team of analysts and stakeholders to improve processes, resolve complex issues, and expand system capabilities that support our employees worldwide.Depending on your experience level, you will operate as either a high\-level functional lead or a strong technical contributor, helping the team navigate the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle through smart technology solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team\-Based Configuration: Collaborate with P\&T(People \& Talent) and other stakeholders to design, configure and test Workday enhancements across various modules. You will help translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.


* Global Support: Provide high\-level end\-user support; help develop and maintain shared user procedures, guidelines, and system documentation.


* System Integrity: Contribute to the overall health of Workday by participating in business process audits and security reviews. Help the team ensure data compliance and offer fast resolution for high\-impact issues.


* Feature Adoption: Join the team in analyzing, testing, and adopting new functionality from semi\-annual Workday releases to keep our platform at the cutting edge.


* Stakeholder Partnership: Build strong relationships with P\&T partners and COEs to help advance Workday adoption and ensure a user\-friendly experience for all employees.


* Shared Problem Solving: Research system problems and identify opportunities for improvement. You will seek opinions and feedback from the broader team to ensure suggested solutions are robust and global\-ready.


* Reporting \& Insights: Help the business make data\-driven decisions by building and maintaining complex reports, calculated fields, and dashboards.



**Experience \& Qualifications**
**Workday Expertise:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Workday configuration.


* We are looking for candidates with experience in one or more functional areas (e.g., Benefits, Payroll, Advanced Compensation, Absence, Talent, Security) but must have a strong HCM background.


* We do not currently have Workday Financials or Recruiting.


* HR Process Knowledge:A strong understanding of global HR processes.


* Collaborative Mindset: A proven ability to work effectively as part of a team in an environment with global members and overlapping time zones.



**Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency with Workday Report Writer and Calculated Fields.


* Experience assisting with data loads and mass updates via EIBs.


* Experience with various HR system configuration outside of Workday a plus (ex. LMS, ATS, Engagement Survey, Rewards).


* Analytical Approach: A strong ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues alongside your peers.


* Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple tasks and contribute to team goals in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.



**Why You’ll Love Working with Us?**



* Work with cutting\-edge technology in a collaborative, global team
* Competitive salary \+ good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more).
* We’re Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!).
* Hybrid work model (3 days in office – Prestige Tech Pacific).
\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-SR1 **Why join Bazaarvoice?**

**Customer is key**
We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.
We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.

**Transparency \& Integrity Builds Trust**
We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA.
We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance.

**Passionate Pursuit of Performance**
Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive \& curiosity.
We love what we do, and because we’re laser focused on our mission.

**Innovation over Imitation**
We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo.
We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage.

**Stronger Together**
We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives.
We champion what’s best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams.
As a stronger company we build a stronger community.

**Regional Teams: Visit our** **APAC Life Page****to see what life is like in our local offices.**

Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world’s smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers.

title: Finance Operations & Strategy Analyst Intern
description:
Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst Intern

**Internship Type:** Full\-Time Internship (6 Months)**Work Mode:** Remote / Hybrid (Based on Business Requirements)**Company:** Magnetar AI Solutions LLP

About Magnetar AI Solutions LLP

Magnetar AI Solutions LLP is an AI, software development, and technology consulting company building intelligent software products, enterprise platforms, SaaS applications, workflow automation systems, and AI\-powered business solutions.

We help businesses improve operational efficiency through technology while developing innovative products for global markets. As an intern, you will gain practical exposure to startup finance, commercial operations, strategic planning, investment readiness, and business growth while working directly with the Founder on real\-world projects.

Internship Overview

We are seeking a motivated **Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst Intern** who is eager to learn finance beyond traditional bookkeeping.

This internship provides practical experience in financial operations, commercial pricing, budgeting, business analytics, investment preparation, SaaS business models, and strategic decision\-making within a fast\-growing AI technology company.

The role is designed for individuals who aspire to build careers in corporate finance, startup finance, business strategy, financial consulting, or entrepreneurship.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

· Startup Finance Operations

· Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)

· Accounting Fundamentals

· Financial Reporting

· Budgeting \& Forecasting

· Cash Flow Planning

· Cost Analysis

· Commercial Pricing Strategy

· SaaS Financial Models

· Business Analytics

· Investment Readiness

· Financial Modelling

· Commercial Proposal Evaluation

· Business Strategy

· Operational Finance

Key ResponsibilitiesFinance Operations

· Assist in maintaining financial records and documentation.

· Support bookkeeping and accounting activities.

· Prepare expense tracking reports.

· Assist in accounts receivable and payable monitoring.

· Support bank reconciliation activities.

· Organize financial documentation for audits and reporting.

Financial Reporting \& Analysis

· Assist in preparing:

o Profit \& Loss Statements

o Balance Sheets

o Cash Flow Reports

o Monthly Financial Summaries

o Business Performance Reports

· Analyze:

o Revenue

o Operating Expenses

o Project Profitability

o Business Performance

o Cost Trends

· Support KPI tracking and management reporting.

Budgeting \& Forecasting

· Assist in preparing annual and quarterly budgets.

· Monitor budget utilization.

· Support cash flow forecasting.

· Analyze budget variances.

· Track organizational burn rate.

· Assist founders with financial planning activities.

Commercial \& Pricing Strategy

· Assist in preparing commercial quotations.

· Support software project pricing.

· Estimate project implementation costs.

· Evaluate project profitability.

· Assist in SaaS pricing analysis.

· Compare pricing against competitors.

· Support proposal costing and commercial evaluations.

Investment \& Strategic Finance

· Prepare financial projections.

· Assist in investor documentation.

· Support investment readiness activities.

· Research funding opportunities.

· Assist in valuation exercises.

· Participate in financial due diligence preparation.

· Maintain investment documentation.

Compliance \& Documentation

· Organize financial records.

· Support statutory documentation.

· Track financial compliance activities.

· Maintain audit\-ready documentation.

· Coordinate documentation required by finance professionals.

Business Operations

· Assist founders in financial decision\-making.

· Evaluate vendor quotations.

· Analyze procurement costs.

· Monitor project financial performance.

· Recommend operational improvements.

· Prepare reports for internal management meetings.

Growth \& Performance Incentives

In addition to finance responsibilities, interns may contribute to strategic business growth initiatives.

Subject to the Company’s Commission, Incentive \& Revenue Sharing Policy, interns may become eligible for performance\-based incentives relating to:

· Investment acquisition support.

· Financial quotation and proposal closures.

· Commercial pricing optimization.

· Strategic cost\-saving initiatives.

· Business growth contributions approved by management.

Required SkillsFinance

· Accounting Fundamentals

· Bookkeeping Principles

· Financial Analysis

· Budgeting Concepts

· Cost Analysis

· Financial Planning

· Business Mathematics

· Analytical Thinking

Technical

· Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice Calc

· LibreOffice Writer \& Impress

· Google Workspace

· Spreadsheet\-based financial modelling

· Documentation and reporting

Preferred Open\-Source Tools

Knowledge of any of the following is an advantage:

· ERPNext

· GnuCash

· Akaunting Community Edition

· Odoo Community Edition

· Dolibarr ERP \& CRM

· Metabase

· Apache Superset

· PostgreSQL (basic knowledge)

Preferred Qualifications

Students or recent graduates pursuing or holding:

· B.Com

· M.Com

· BBA

· MBA (Finance)

· CA Intermediate

· CMA

· ACCA

· CFA (Level I or pursuing)

· Any Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or Business\-related qualification

Freshers with a strong willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

Desired Competencies

· Strong analytical mindset

· Numerical aptitude

· Professional integrity

· High attention to detail

· Problem\-solving ability

· Business curiosity

· Self\-learning attitude

· Time management

· Communication skills

· Ownership and accountability

· Team collaboration

Internship Benefits

· Work directly with the Founder.

· Exposure to startup finance and AI businesses.

· Hands\-on experience with live commercial projects.

· Learn SaaS pricing and financial strategy.

· Gain exposure to investment readiness and fundraising.

· Build practical skills in financial reporting and business analytics.

· Structured mentorship and continuous learning.

· Internship Completion Certificate upon successful completion.

· Opportunity to be considered for future full\-time roles based on performance and business requirements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

· Accuracy of financial work.

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quality of financial reports.

· Commercial quotation support.

· Financial analysis quality.

· Business improvement recommendations.

· Documentation standards.

· Professional conduct.

· Learning attitude.

· Contribution to organizational objectives.

Career Growth Path

Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst Intern

↓

Junior Finance Operations Analyst

↓

Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst

↓

Senior Finance Analyst

↓

Finance Manager

↓

Financial Controller

↓

Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Commission \& Incentive Eligibility

Eligible interns may participate in the Company’s Commission, Incentive \& Revenue Sharing Policy, including:

· Investment Acquisition Growth Commission

· Financial Quotation Closure Commission

· Strategic Cost Optimization Incentives

· Business Growth Performance Incentives

All commissions are discretionary and subject to Company policy, management approval, realized revenue, or successful investment closure.

Why Join Magnetar AI Solutions LLP?

· Work on real startup finance challenges.

· Learn finance within an AI and technology company.

· Build commercial, strategic, and analytical skills.

· Collaborate directly with decision\-makers.

· Gain exposure to product businesses, SaaS models, and global expansion strategies.

· Accelerate your professional growth through meaningful, hands\-on experience.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Magnetar AI Solutions LLP is committed to providing an inclusive, collaborative, and learning\-oriented environment. We welcome passionate individuals who are eager to develop their careers in finance, business strategy, innovation, and technology while contributing to impactful projects.

description:
**Job description**

**Job Title** **: Fresher Software Tester**

**Technology/Area** **:JAVA , MANUAL , AUTOMATION**

**Experience Required** **: 0\- 1 years**

**Educational Qualification(s)** **: BE/B.Tech (CS) Only**

**Job Overview** **:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Fresher Software Tester to join our quality assurance team. As a Software Tester, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through thorough testing and validation**.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Test Case Design: Develop and execute test cases based on requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manual Testing: Perform manual testing of software applications across various platforms (web, mobile, desktop).
* Defect Identification: Identify, document, and track bugs or issues using bug\-tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Bugzilla).
* Regression Testing: Conduct regression testing to ensure that new code changes do not adversely affect existing functionality.
* Collaboration: Work closely with developers, business analysts, and product managers to understand requirements and provide feedback on test coverage and quality.
* Test Documentation: Prepare and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test scripts, and test reports.
* Automation (Optional): Assist in the development and maintenance of automated test scripts (if applicable).
* User Experience Testing: Evaluate the user experience to ensure that the application meets the users expectations.

**Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of Testing Methodologies: Basic understanding of software testing methodologies, testing life cycle, and software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Attention to Detail: Strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with team members.
* Problem\-Solving: Ability to think critically and solve problems effectively.
* Tools Knowledge: Familiarity with testing tools like Selenium, JIRA, TestRail, etc. (preferred but not mandatory).
* Eagerness to Learn: Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and processes.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C\#.

description:
**Job Title: Associate Data Engineer / Junior Data Engineer (Fresher)**

**Job Type:** Full\-time  

**Experience Level:** Fresher (0\-1 Years)

**About the Role:**


We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented **Associate Data Engineer** to join our growing data team. If you are a recent graduate passionate about data and eager to build a career in data engineering, this is the perfect opportunity for you!


In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers to build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines. You will get hands\-on experience with modern data infrastructure, transitioning your basic academic or project\-level knowledge into production\-grade skills. We focus heavily on mentorship, ensuring you have the support you need to grow as a professional.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Pipeline Development:** Assist in writing and maintaining ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) scripts to move data across various systems.
* **Database Management:** Write basic SQL queries, create tables, and interact with **PostgreSQL** databases to support data storage and retrieval.
* **Data Orchestration:** Help schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot automated data workflows using **Apache Airflow**.
* **Stream Processing:** Collaborate with the team to build and monitor real\-time or near\-real\-time data streaming applications using **Apache Flink**.
* **Coding \& Debugging:** Write clean, readable, and well\-documented code in **Python**.
* **Continuous Learning:** Actively participate in code reviews, learn best practices from senior team members, and stay updated on the latest data engineering trends.

 **Must\-Have Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field (Recent graduates from batch \[Year] are welcome).
* **Python:** Solid foundational knowledge of Python programming (data structures, loops, functions, basic libraries like Pandas).
* **PostgreSQL (SQL):** Basic understanding of relational databases, table design, and the ability to write standard SQL queries (SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY).
* **Apache Airflow:** Theoretical understanding or project\-level exposure to how Airflow works (DAGs, tasks, scheduling).
* **Apache Flink:** Basic conceptual knowledge of distributed data processing or stream processing using Flink.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and a genuine eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

 **Good\-to\-Have (Bonus Points):**

* **Spatial Data:** Knowledge of the **PostGIS** extension for PostgreSQL and a basic understanding of how to write geo/spatial queries.
* **Version Control:** Basic understanding of tools like **Git/GitHub**.
* **Cloud Basics:** Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* **OS:** Comfortable with basic Linux/Unix command\-line operations.
* **Portfolio:** Any personal or academic projects showcasing data pipelines or data processing.

icogz is a technology company focused on building innovative digital solutions that help businesses improve operations, streamline processes, and enhance their digital presence. We work on modern web platforms, enterprise applications, and customer\-facing digital experiences that support business growth and transformation.

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented CMS Intern to support the maintenance and content management of our WordPress websites. This internship is ideal for students, fresh graduates, or individuals looking to gain hands\-on experience in website management, content publishing, digital marketing support, and WordPress administration.

The selected candidate will work closely with content creators, designers, marketers, and developers to ensure website content remains accurate, up\-to\-date, visually consistent, and aligned with brand guidelines.

* Track content updates and maintain content publishing records.

**Learning \& Development**

* Learn WordPress administration and content management best practices.
* Gain exposure to website analytics, SEO fundamentals, and digital marketing workflows.
* Stay updated on content publishing standards and web content trends.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of websites and content management systems.
* Familiarity with WordPress or a willingness to learn quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Basic understanding of formatting, layouts, and web content presentation.
* Ability to follow instructions and work independently.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar productivity tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience using WordPress, Blogger, Wix, Squarespace, or similar CMS platforms.
* Familiarity with basic SEO concepts.
* Experience using Canva or similar design tools for simple image editing.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva AI, or similar productivity tools.
* Interest in digital marketing, content management, or website administration.

**Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Digital Marketing
* Mass Communication
* Journalism
* Business Administration
* Multimedia or related fields
* Freshers and students are encouraged to apply.

**What You'll Learn**

* WordPress CMS administration and content publishing workflows.
* Website content management best practices.
* SEO fundamentals and on\-page optimization techniques.
* Website quality assurance and content review processes.
* Collaboration with marketing, design, and development teams.

* Has strong attention to detail.

* Is organized, dependable, and proactive.

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**


**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**


You are part of a team in India responsible for building sustainable cocoa sourcing strategies to meet Cocoa\-Life objectives on best practices in sustainable cocoa farming, improving livelihoods in cocoa communities, protecting the forest and the environment, and building and maintaining Mondelēz International’s reputation.


**How you will contribute**


You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the nursery, ensuring that processes are strictly followed and that the Cocoa nursery is well\-tended and respected. To help with benchmarking and performance improvement, you will closely track KPIs and regularly report on their progress. You will also conduct education in the field about cocoa, including educating others about how cocoa is grown, why cocoa should be planted, good agricultural practices (GAP), and how to implement sustainability initiatives (e.g. training women, drip irrigation and supporting marginal farmers). In addition, you will:


* Work with government officials in horticulture and agriculture departments to implement cocoa programs.
* Collect data for crop forecasting and market intelligence for pricing decisions.
* Work with third\-party operations for cocoa procurement and processing.

**What you will bring**


A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career with experience and knowledge in:


* Strong analytics and process discipline
* Hands\-on knowledge of agriculture with a commercial orientation
* Communication, with strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to work alone and independently without direct supervision

**More about this role \-**

The Technical executive managing the Cocoa operations at Andhra Pradesh locations should be able to deliver as per the job responsibilities listed below which will ensure effective involves the promotion of cocoa crops among farmers, training Cocoa GAP, Management of nurseries, Cocoa Life activities, Cocoa procurement, quality control and bean dispatch to factories. The resource should be good at Agronomy, Horticulture, Farmer training and extensive field visits, Nursery management, networking with farming \& rural communities. The resource should be a committed team person building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. * **Cocoa Procurement** – Coordinate with third\-party buying partners who operate on a commission\-per\-kilo basis. Receive and account for cocoa deliveries at collection sites. Monitor quality of beans purchased against specific quality requirements. Manage documentation and dispatch of beans to factory. Effectively train farmers on Post\-Harvest and Quality management.
* **Cocoa Life Program** – Involve in Cocoa Life programs like Community Development Programs through NGO partnerships, Young Farm Survey, Agro\-forestry, CSR and Sustainability program Mondelez International Internal
* **People management** – Cocoa Nursery and TPO collection staff, workers education on quality requirement.
* **Research \& Institutional Collaboration** – Support research projects with institutions such as Kerala Agriculture University and CPCRI. Assist senior staff on research and project\-related activities.
* **Government \& Stakeholder Liaison** – Liaise with local government officials, Horticulture and Agriculture Departments at village level. Coordinate with Govt depts including FSSAI and other licenses as required.
* Implementing Sustainability and Safety Initiatives.
* **Digital Onboarding** of Farmers, Polygon mapping of Farms and Digital tools for procurement

**Education / Certifications:**

* BSc. Agriculture/ Horticulture/Forestry or MSc in Botany
* Exceptional talent with Diploma in Agriculture
* Knowledge of South Indian languages ideally Telugu \& Hindi are essential.

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.

title: Technical Executive
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**


**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**


You are part of a team in India responsible for building sustainable cocoa sourcing strategies to meet Cocoa\-Life objectives on best practices in sustainable cocoa farming, improving livelihoods in cocoa communities, protecting the forest and the environment, and building and maintaining Mondelēz International’s reputation.


**How you will contribute**


You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the nursery, ensuring that processes are strictly followed and that the Cocoa nursery is well\-tended and respected. To help with benchmarking and performance improvement, you will closely track KPIs and regularly report on their progress. You will also conduct education in the field about cocoa, including educating others about how cocoa is grown, why cocoa should be planted, good agricultural practices (GAP), and how to implement sustainability initiatives (e.g. training women, drip irrigation and supporting marginal farmers). In addition, you will:


* Work with government officials in horticulture and agriculture departments to implement cocoa programs.
* Collect data for crop forecasting and market intelligence for pricing decisions.
* Work with third\-party operations for cocoa procurement and processing.

**What you will bring**


A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career with experience and knowledge in:


* Strong analytics and process discipline
* Hands\-on knowledge of agriculture with a commercial orientation
* Communication, with strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to work alone and independently without direct supervision

Additional Job Description
**More about this role \-**

The Technical executive managing the Cocoa operations at Andhra Pradesh locations should be able to deliver as per the job responsibilities listed below which will ensure effective involves the promotion of cocoa crops among farmers, training Cocoa GAP, Management of nurseries, Cocoa Life activities, Cocoa procurement, quality control and bean dispatch to factories. The resource should be good at Agronomy, Horticulture, Farmer training and extensive field visits, Nursery management, networking with farming \& rural communities. The resource should be a committed team person building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The person should be committed towards fulfilling Mondelez's policies and compliance requirements and implement Cocoa Life initiatives towards achieving economic, social, and environmental sustainability.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* **Cocoa Area development** – Farmer identification and new area identification
* **Cocoa Crop Science** – Nursery Management, P\&D management, Agronomy, Extension and farmer retention
* **Cocoa Procurement** – Coordinate with third\-party buying partners who operate on a commission\-per\-kilo basis. Receive and account for cocoa deliveries at collection sites. Monitor quality of beans purchased against specific quality requirements. Manage documentation and dispatch of beans to factory. Effectively train farmers on Post\-Harvest and Quality management.
* **Cocoa Life Program** – Involve in Cocoa Life programs like Community Development Programs through NGO partnerships, Young Farm Survey, Agro\-forestry, CSR and Sustainability program Mondelez International Internal
* **People management** – Cocoa Nursery and TPO collection staff, workers education on quality requirement.
* **Research \& Institutional Collaboration** – Support research projects with institutions such as Kerala Agriculture University and CPCRI. Assist senior staff on research and project\-related activities.
* **Government \& Stakeholder Liaison** – Liaise with local government officials, Horticulture and Agriculture Departments at village level. Coordinate with Govt depts including FSSAI and other licenses as required.
* Implementing Sustainability and Safety Initiatives.
* **Digital Onboarding** of Farmers, Polygon mapping of Farms and Digital tools for procurement

**Education / Certifications:**

* BSc. Agriculture/ Horticulture/Forestry or MSc in Botany
* Exceptional talent with Diploma in Agriculture
* Knowledge of South Indian languages ideally Telugu \& Hindi are essential.

**Job specific requirements:**

***Experience \-***


* Freshers are welcome to apply
* 0–4 years of experience in agriculture, horticulture, or related field
* Experienced candidates from seed companies, fertilizer companies, or agri\-related firms are also considered

***Field Readiness \-***


* Role requires extensive field visits involving travel to farms
* Practical field readiness is essential

***Skills \-***


* Hands on Knowledge of Agriculture
* Commercial Orientation
* Innovation, Communication and Negotiation skills
* Computer skills – AI, Excel, Word, Power Point
* Accounting – Tally/SAP/Data analysis/Taxes

***Competencies \-***


* Organization, planning and management
* Attention to detail
* Analytical thinking
* Human relations and influencing
* Teamwork
* Interpersonal effectiveness
* Application of knowledge
* Persistence and ability to update

**Travel requirements:** Role requires extensive field visits involving travel to farms.


\&\#xa;\&\#xa;
No Relocation support available
**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------


### **Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth\-watering and well\-loved local and global brands such as** ***Cadbury*** **chocolates,** ***Bournvita*** **and** ***Tang*** **powdered beverages,** ***Oreo*** **and** ***Cadbury Bournvita*** **biscuits, and** ***Halls*** **and** ***Cadbury Choclairs Gold*** **candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths*****.*** **Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research \& Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 – the fourth time we’ve received this award.**


Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


**Job Type**
------------


Regular

Corporate \& Government Affairs

description:

**Mandatory: Should have a profile at https://aiopsenabler.com**

**Company:** AiOps Enabler  
**Internship Duration:** 1–3 Months  
**Internship Type:** Internship  
**Domain:** Artificial Intelligence \| AIOps \| AI Agents \| DevOps

About AiOps Enabler

AiOps Enabler is building a **discovery, evaluation, and trust ecosystem for AI agents**. The platform aims to help developers showcase their AI agents while enabling users and organizations to discover, evaluate, compare, and understand agents through transparent profiles, ratings, performance signals, and other trust indicators.

We are looking for curious and enthusiastic interns who want to explore the rapidly evolving world of **AI Agents, Agentic AI, AIOps, DevOps, and AI communities**.

What You Will Work On

As an **AIOps Research \& Community Intern**, you will:

* Research emerging **AI agents, Agentic AI platforms, AIOps tools, and AI startups**
* Discover interesting AI agents and open\-source AI projects from GitHub and other public sources
* Research how AI agents are being used across DevOps, Cloud, Observability, Security, Customer Support, Automation, and other domains
* Help identify and categorize AI agents for the AiOps Enabler ecosystem
* Study trends and developments in the AI agent ecosystem
* Create short research summaries, insights, and educational content
* Contribute ideas for improving AI agent discovery and evaluation
* Engage with developers, students, AI enthusiasts, and communities
* Help grow the **AiOps Enabler developer and student community**
* Participate in discussions around AI agent trust, performance, ratings, and verification

Who Can Apply

This internship is ideal for:

* B.Tech / BE / BCA / MCA / BSc / MSc students
* Computer Science, IT, AI/ML, Data Science, or related backgrounds
* Freshers interested in **AI, AIOps, DevOps, Cloud, or Agentic AI**
* Students who enjoy researching new technologies and experimenting with AI tools
* Candidates interested in building their professional presence within the AI ecosystem

**No extensive professional experience is required.**

Curiosity, research ability, communication skills, and a willingness to learn are more important.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will gain exposure to:

**AI Agents \& Agentic AI**  
Understand how modern AI agents are built, deployed, evaluated, and used.

**AIOps \& DevOps**  
Learn how AI is transforming IT operations, observability, incident management, automation, and DevOps.

**AI Agent Ecosystem Research**  
Explore real AI agents, open\-source projects, frameworks, platforms, and emerging technologies.

**Community Building**  
Learn how technology communities grow through developer engagement, research, content, and collaboration.

**Professional Visibility**  
Build knowledge, contribute to an emerging AI ecosystem, and develop experience that can strengthen your LinkedIn profile and resume.

What We're Looking For

You don't need to be an AI expert.

You should have:

* Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence
* Curiosity about AI agents and emerging technologies
* Basic understanding of software/technology
* Good internet research skills
* Good written communication
* Willingness to learn independently
* Ability to contribute consistently during the internship

Knowledge of **Python, GitHub, DevOps, Cloud, or AI/ML** is an added advantage but not mandatory.

Why Join?

AI agents are rapidly becoming a new layer of the software ecosystem.

This internship gives you an opportunity to **learn about the ecosystem while actively contributing to it**, rather than only studying AI through courses and tutorials.

Join us in building a community around **discoverable, measurable, and trusted AI agents.**

**Explore AiOps Enabler:** aiopsenabler.com

**Learn. Research. Contribute. Build your presence in the AI Agent ecosystem.**

**Graphic \& Branding Designer (Remote)**

**About Us**

At **MarketMe.io**, we don't just create content, we build brands that leave a lasting impression.

We're a fast\-growing creative marketing agency working with premium brands across hospitality, healthcare, F\&B, retail, luxury, lifestyle, and international markets. Our work is rooted in strategy, elevated by aesthetics, and driven by design excellence.

We're looking for a **Graphic \& Branding Designer** who lives and breathes design. Someone who understands that great branding is far more than choosing beautiful colours or fonts. It's about creating visual systems that communicate, influence, and inspire.

If you're obsessed with typography, layout, branding psychology, visual hierarchy, and premium aesthetics, and you have the ability to transform ideas into world\-class visual identities, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**

This isn't a role for someone who simply operates design software.

We're looking for a creative thinker with exceptional design taste who understands branding from a strategic perspective and can execute with precision.

You should be capable of building complete visual identities, creating high\-performing marketing creatives, designing premium packaging, and maintaining consistency across every brand touchpoint.

Every design you create should have purpose, balance, and a story behind it.

**Key ResponsibilitiesBrand Identity \& Strategy**

* Develop complete brand identities from scratch, including logos, typography systems, colour palettes, brand guidelines, visual language, and design systems.
* Ensure brand consistency across every digital and print touchpoint.
* Understand how design influences perception, positioning, and customer behaviour.

**Graphic Design \& Marketing Collateral**

Create visually compelling and conversion\-focused:

* Social Media Creatives
* Instagram Carousels
* Meta \& Google Ad Creatives
* Brochures
* Company Profiles
* Pitch Decks
* Presentations
* Restaurant Menus
* Event Branding
* POSM
* Print Collateral
* Outdoor Media
* Marketing Campaign Assets

**Packaging \& Print Design**

* Design premium product packaging, labels, boxes, sleeves, merchandise, and print collateral.
* Prepare accurate print\-ready artwork with proper die\-lines, bleeds, colour profiles, and production specifications.

**Typography \& Editorial Design**

A strong understanding of typography is **non\-negotiable**.

You should have hands\-on knowledge of:

* Font Pairing
* Typography Psychology
* Kerning
* Tracking
* Leading
* Baseline Grids
* Editorial Layouts
* White Space
* Visual Hierarchy
* Grid Systems
* Composition
* Information Flow

You should know *why* a particular typeface works, not just *which* one looks good.

**Creative Research \& Trend Execution**

* Stay ahead of global design trends.
* Continuously explore luxury branding, editorial design, packaging trends, colour systems, and premium visual storytelling.
* Execute modern design styles without relying on templates or repetitive concepts.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with strategists, copywriters, content creators, video editors, and account managers to translate creative briefs into impactful visual experiences.

**What We're Looking ForExperience**

* 3\+ years of professional experience in Graphic Design \& Branding.
* Agency experience is highly preferred.

**Freshers are also encouraged to apply** if you possess an exceptional portfolio that demonstrates outstanding design thinking, premium aesthetics, and strong branding capabilities.

Talent will always outweigh years of experience.

**The Portfolio**

Your portfolio should demonstrate:

* Premium Branding Projects
* Original Logo Design
* Brand Identity Systems
* Typography\-Driven Design
* Packaging Design
* Editorial Layouts
* Social Media Campaigns
* Marketing Creatives
* Print Design
* Visual Storytelling

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (FS)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are building a next\-generation product engineering organization where we are looking for Business Analysts who will transform business problems, customer needs, and market opportunities into well\-defined product capabilities that engineering teams can build with confidence.
 



  





 The Business Analyst will combine
 **strong business analysis skills, product thinking, domain modelling, systems thinking,** 
 and AI\-assisted analysis to discover requirements, define product behavior, and enable rapid product delivery.
 



 This role focuses on
 **understanding customer journeys, analyzing complex business domains, documenting functional and non\-functional requirements, modelling business processes, and collaborating across product, engineering, architecture, and AI teams.** 
 We are looking for analysts who can effectively use AI as a force multiplier to accelerate research, documentation, requirement analysis, and product discovery while ensuring business accuracy and completeness.
 



  





**Experience level** 
 : 5 to 10 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Discovery:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, customers, domain experts, and engineering teams to discover business problems and identify product opportunities.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, and collaborative discovery sessions.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined product capabilities and solution requirements.



  





**Business Analysis:** 



* Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and digital transformation.
* Define functional and non\-functional requirements for product capabilities.
* Document business rules, workflows, decision logic, user journeys, and system interactions.
* Maintain complete traceability from business objectives through implementation.



  





**Domain Modelling \& Product Design:** 



* Develop and maintain business domain models that accurately represent customer processes, products, entities, relationships, and business events.
* Bring the perspective of FS centric regulatory requirements, financial security context to product design.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure domain models align with system architecture and product design.
* Continuously refine domain models as product capabilities evolve.



  





**Requirements Engineering:** 



* Prepare high\-quality: User Stories, Epics, Features, Acceptance Criteria, Business Rules, Functional Specifications, Process Flows, Decision Models
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, implementable, and aligned with business objectives.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, UX Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Clarify business requirements during development and testing.
* Support product validation and customer acceptance activities.



  





**AI\-Augmented Business Analysis:** 



* Use AI\-powered tools to accelerate market research, business analysis, requirement documentation, user story creation, process modelling, and product documentation.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for business correctness, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Apply AI responsibly while maintaining domain expertise and analytical rigor.



  





**Product Validation:** 



* Participate in product demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and solution validation.
* Verify implemented functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA teams to ensure comprehensive business test coverage.
* Gather customer feedback and continuously improve product capabilities.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong experience in Business Analysis within software product development environments.
* **Financial Services Domain Knowledge**
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience of creating business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies.
* Experience with business process modelling and workflow analysis.
* Familiarity with modern product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, or similar platforms.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools to improve business analysis, documentation, and research productivity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Product Thinking, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)
* Business Process Management (BPM)
* Customer Journey Mapping
* AI\-assisted Product Discovery
* Design Thinking
* Systems Thinking



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 




 Within the first year, you will:
 


* Successfully translate complex customer problems into clear, implementable product requirements.
* Develop reusable business domain models that improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
* Improve requirement quality, reducing ambiguity and downstream rework.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver features faster through well\-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Be the custodian for the product backlog in the respective product area.
* Help establish AI\-assisted business analysis practices that improve productivity while maintaining business accuracy.
* Contribute to building customer\-centric, scalable, and high\-quality software products that solve real business problems.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 We are looking for a Business Analyst – GBO Support to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.
   

  

 Our diverse team for is growing and we would love to talk with you, if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
   

  

 Passionate about understanding complex business processes, the strategic impact of digital tools on operational excellence, and how digital systems can optimize them.
   

 Have a strong background in business analysis, IT operations, data\-driven problem solving, and driving digital transformation initiatives in collaboration with functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Love being creative through identifying opportunities for efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement using digital solutions.
   

 Take ownership and independently drive towards desired outcomes
   

 Know about developing strategic roadmaps for IT enablement, operational optimization through digital tools, and effective collaboration frameworks across digital functions.
   

 Have experience working in cross\-functional teams, bridging the gap between business and IT stakeholders.
   

 Are a team player who takes ownership, builds cross\-functional relationships with peers and loves sharing knowledge with others
   

 Proactively manage relevant stakeholders
   

 Are curious, self\-directed and want to keep learning!
   

  

 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
   

 The must\-haves we see for this role is though:
   

  

 Proven experience as a Business Analyst with a strong focus on IT systems, operational efficiency, and digital transformation.
   

 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, interpret, and present data to identify bottlenecks, opportunities for optimization, and the impact of digital solutions.
   

 Demonstrated ability to establish and manage governance processes that rigorously track the impact of IT incidents and system performance on Global Business Operations (GBO) Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), driving accountability and continuous operational improvement
   

  

 The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day\-to\-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
   

  

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 
  

 You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front line obsessed company by ensuring that Global Business Operations are seamlessly powered by digital innovation, leading to a low\-cost, agile, and customer\-centric IKEA experience.
   

  

 This mean that you will:
   

  

 Partner closely with the GBO function to deeply understand existing operational processes, digital system utilization, and identify opportunities for optimization and digital tool adoption.
   

 Gather and analyse data from various sources to identify IT\-related bottlenecks and areas where digital systems can be leveraged for greater operational efficiency and cost savings.
   

 Bridge the gap between business needs and IT capabilities, translating GBO requirements into actionable IT solutions and improvements, actively collaborating with Digital Functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Design, implement, and run a governance framework to track the impact of IT incidents, digital tool implementations, and operational improvements on GBO KPIs and overall business value.
   

 Proactively identify, evaluate, and propose automation opportunities and new digital tools within existing GBO processes to drive significant operational efficiency and cost benefits for the company.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 We see ourselves as influencers – we steer the IKEA business by finding the truth behind the figures. Together we secure compliance with local and international laws and reporting standards; we assure that accounting processes are efficient and that tax compliance meets business needs. We’re a diverse group of people driven by providing reliable financial data to a wide variety of stakeholders. At the end of the day, that’s one of the foundations to make IKEA even better!

title: AP People Analytics Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


This role sits at the intersection of people analytics and AI\-enabled workflow automation, while also supporting selected strategic People initiatives across BCG’s Asia Pacific region.

  

You will own core regional people reporting and analytics, while working closely with your manager on high\-priority initiatives such as People Survey transformation, AP AI Boost Project, Talent 2030 and more. You will own defined analyses and project workstreams—from structuring the problem and conducting analysis to synthesizing insights and preparing materials for senior stakeholders.

  

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with structured problem solving, curiosity and a hands\-on approach to using AI tools to improve how work gets done.

 **Essential duties and responsibilities:**

 **1\. People Analytics and Reporting**

* **Monthly People Metrics Reporting**
* + Own the end\-to\-end delivery of monthly capacity and attrition analyses, from processing source data to identifying key trends, surfacing discrepancies against the global dashboard, investigating underlying drivers, and aligning on the appropriate approach to resolution
	+ Coordinate inputs across AP people teams, manage release timelines, and ensure the monthly reporting is delivered accurately and on schedule
	  
	
	+ Proactively translate analysis into clear insights and potential next steps, aligning with senior stakeholders where appropriate
* **People Survey and Pulse Survey**
* + Work closely with your manager to shape the design and execution of AP’s new People Survey analytics approach under the updated global survey tools, including identifying opportunities to enhance analysis and reporting with AI
	+ Develop targeted data cuts, trend views and follow\-up analyses to uncover underlying drivers and support interpretation and communication of People Survey results in AP
	+ Coordinate with the Global People Team on survey administration; Manage analytical requests from AP systems as part of the survey process (scope may evolve as new tools are rolled out)
* **Planning Cycle Support**
* + Act as PoC for People Function post planning process, obtaining plan data from Finance and coordinating across People and Finance stakeholders on data requests and validation
	+ Analyze how capacity and workforce composition evolve across the planning cycle, highlighting key movements and implications for the AP People function
* **Other Regular/ad\-hoc Reporting**
* + Own other recurring analytical reports, including BST ratios analysis, leverage analysis, APPT Scorecard, attrition analysis, FTE analysis and CDA survey analysis; take on additional ad\-hoc or regular analyses as business priorities evolve
	+ With oversight from your manager, prepare senior\-ready materials on attrition, recruiting and capacity for leadership discussions, and respond to follow\-up questions through targeted analysis

**2\. AI Workflow and Automation**

* Build and maintain AI\-enabled reporting workflows, including automating recurring reports and dashboards developed in collaboration with your manager
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring AP People function processes; propose and execute improvements under the guidance of your manager
* Document and share your approaches with the AP People team and regional office colleagues, enabling broader adoption and continuous improvement

**3\. Strategic People Projects Support**

* Provide analytical and project support across strategic regional People initiatives, including REACHES (AP HR transformation), AI Boost Talent Pillar (AP program to accelerate AI upskilling), Talent 2030, Strategic Workforce planning, as well as other projects that emerge over time
* Own defined analyses or project workstreams with oversight from your manager, from structuring the question and developing the approach to synthesizing findings into clear, senior\-ready outputs

**4\. Reporting Operations and Data Quality**

* Maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions, methodologies and reporting processes to ensure continuity, consistency and transparency across People Analytics
* Proactively identify and resolve data discrepancies, working with source teams to investigate root causes and implement sustainable solutions

**5\. Network**

* Proactively engage with BCG’s global analytics team to stay current on available tools, reporting standards and best practices, while surfacing AP\-specific needs and perspectives
* Build working relationships with people analytics peers in EMESA and NAMR to share approaches and align on common methodologies where relevant
* Maintain strong relationship with BCG’s system HR teams, particularly in the context of people survey coordination and AP data analysis requests

  

What You'll Bring

**EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor degree in Business, Computer Science, Statistics, Human Resources, or related disciplines combined with 4 to 6 years working experience; Previous experience in consulting, analytics, or other structured problem\-solving environment is a strong plus
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code) alongside Python and Power Automate to build, maintain and improve automated reporting workflows. Familiarity with HR data and Workday is a plus.
* Strong analytical acumen and rigor about data accuracy, with a habit of cross\-checking and triangulating figures before releasing outputs to stakeholders. Strong creative problem solving with ability to craft tailored solutions to meet the wide range of business needs.
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail; able to manage multiple workstreams, meet deadlines and flag issues proactively. Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment with direction from a senior manager.

  

Who You'll Work With


You will report into the Asia Pacific (AP) Consulting (CT) Performance \& Change Senior Manager and be part of the AP People Team.

  

You will work closely with your manager on a day\-to\-day basis. You will also work directly on requests from senior People function leaders including the AP Consulting People Team Executive Director, the AP CHRO and AP People Chair. Beyond this, you will interact with peers across the AP People function (recruiting, career development \& staffing, Teaming, etc.), AP Finance function, EMESA/NAMR People function and BCG’s global analytics teams

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Build and maintain effective relationships with external stakeholders, including legal counsel, payroll providers, government agencies, and HR vendors, as needed.
* Monitor workforce, labor market, and legislative trends, providing recommendations to leadership on policy updates, employment practices, talent strategies, and operational improvements.
* Prepare and present workforce reports, metrics, and insights to leadership, including analysis of staffing, retention, engagement, talent acquisition, and employee relations trends.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in a business\-related field
* 8 years of progressive HR experience with proficiency in employee relations, talent acquisition, performance management, leadership coaching, compliance, and HR operations.
* Demonstrated success influencing leaders, resolving complex employee issues, and supporting organizational growth and talent strategies.
* Experience partnering with U.S. based HR teams and business leaders within a multinational organization
* Experience serving as the primary HR resource for a business unit, location, or organization.
* Experience partnering with remote leaders, local business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Prior leadership experience preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor and employment laws.
* Fluent verbal and written communication skills with Kannada (Mysuru dialect) and English.
* Strong employee relations, investigation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate in a matrixed organization where HR responsibilities are shared across multiple functional experts and business partners.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective partnerships across multiple functions, business units, and geographic locations while balancing local business needs with enterprise objectives.
* Ability to build credibility and effective working relationships at all organizational levels.
* Excellent judgment, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive matters.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and HR information systems.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones.
* Ability to operate independently while remaining highly collaborative with stakeholders.

 Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for extended periods of time.

 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than

 worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**About This Role**
 This is predominantly a leadership role within the Learning \& Organizational Development (L\&OD) function. We are looking for a seasoned professional who combines sharp strategic thinking with strong execution capability — someone who can design, drive, and scale impactful learning and organizational development initiatives while also partnering closely with business leaders to build capability and culture.
   

  

* Strategic Learning Delivery \& Business Impact
* Lead the design and execution of the Open Enrollment Learning Calendar, Management Development programs, and enterprise L\&OD initiatives aligned to business strategy.
* Partner with business leaders to identify capability gaps and build targeted learning journeys for emerging and senior leaders.
* Deliver high\-impact facilitation sessions (20\-30 hours/month) across virtual, in\-person, and hybrid formats.
* Apply measurement frameworks such as Kirkpatrick (Levels 1\-4\) to evaluate effectiveness, impact, and ROI of learning programs.
* Instruction Design \& AI\-Enabled Learning
* Design learner\-centric solutions using ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and adult learning principles.
* Build structured learning journeys, microlearning, and blended programs incorporating experiential methodologies (case studies, simulations, real\-world problem solving).
* Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Synthesia, Glean, etc.) to design, personalize, and scale learning experiences — AI fluency is a critical requirement for this role.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled learning solutions to enhance efficiency, learner engagement, and content effectiveness.
* Ensure seamless integration of content within LMS platforms.
* Talent Development \& Succession Enablement
* Partner in talent review cycles to identify high\-potential talent and critical skill gaps.
* Design and implement individualized and cohort\-based development plans aligned with succession pipelines and leadership capability building.
* Aligning learning strategies with career frameworks and long\-term organizational capability needs.
* Strategic Learning Projects
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale training and capability\-building initiatives (leadership development, functional academies, enterprise interventions).
* Define project scope, timelines, success metrics, and governance.
* Manage cross\-functional stakeholders and external vendors to ensure high\-quality delivery within timelines and budgets.
* Track risks, monitor outcomes, and present insights to senior leadership.
* Organizational Development \& Business Partnership
* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on organization effectiveness, capability building, and culture transformation.
* Diagnose organizational needs and recommend targeted OD interventions including team effectiveness, leadership alignment, and change initiatives.
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of L\&OD professionals, building strong capability in facilitation, instructional design, and consulting skills.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Enable team members to effectively leverage digital and AI tools in learning design and delivery.
* Learning Analytics \& Insights
* Track, analyze, and interpret learning data (participation, engagement, effectiveness, business impact).
* Build dashboards and executive reports on talent readiness and capability outcomes.
* Use data\-driven insights to continuously refine learning strategies and interventions.
* Education:
* MBA in HR / Master’s in Organizational Psychology or related field (preferred)
* Experience:
* 15\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, or Organizational Development
* Proven experience leading large\-scale, cross\-functional L\&OD initiatives
* Core Expertise:
* Strong instructional design expertise (ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, adult learning principles)
* Deep experience in leadership development and capability building
* Strong facilitation and executive presence
* AI \& Digital Capability (Critical Requirement):
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Glean, Synthesia, etc.) in learning design, content creation, and personalization
* Ability to integrate AI into learning strategy, delivery, and analytics
* Strong digital fluency with LMS platforms and learning technologies
* Technical \& Analytical Skills:
* Expertise in LMS platforms (Docebo or similar)
* Advanced MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and data visualization tools
* Knowledge of Kirkpatrick Model and learning ROI measurement
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capability
* Leadership \& Consulting Skills:
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills with senior leadership
* Ability to operate as both strategic advisor and execution leader
* Experience managing and developing high\-performing teams
* Certifications (Preferred):
* Instructional Design, Facilitation certifications
* Assessments/tools such as MBTI, Harrison, Situational Leadership II
* Other Requirements:
* Comfortable working in global environments (including periodic East Coast shift alignment)

 As one of our first People hires on the ground, you’ll do a bit of everything — hiring great people, running smooth onboarding and payroll, handling day\-to\-day employee relations, and keeping us compliant with local law.
 



  





 This is a build\-and\-operate role in a start\-up\-style environment: no big team beneath you, just the chance to own the work, move fast, and grow with the company. If you like variety, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves problem solving, and being the person people count on, this one’s for you.
 



  





 Your next 5 minutes could put you on our shortlist — click Apply to start your application (a short, simple step to put you in the running) →
 **https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/7BW9NMT** 




  





**Role Snapshot** 




 Location / Schedule: Remote within India, Full\-Time
 



  





 Purpose: Run Mercola’s day\-to\-day People operations in India as a hands\-on generalist — recruiting, onboarding, payroll, employee relations, and compliance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own full\-cycle recruiting for India roles — sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and closing offers.
* Run smooth onboarding so new hires are set up, supported, and productive from week one.
* Manage payroll inputs and coordinate with the payroll provider; keep benefits and records accurate.
* Handle everyday employee relations — questions, concerns, and simple investigations — fairly and discreetly.
* Keep us compliant with Indian labor law and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, etc.); maintain policies, contracts, and handbooks.
* Maintain HRIS data (Dayforce) and keep employee records clean and current.
* Support engagement and culture initiatives that reflect Mercola’s wellness\-focused, transparent values.
* Partner with global HR and local leaders on process and day\-to\-day people needs.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 5 years of hands\-on HR generalist experience in India.
* Direct experience across most of: recruiting, onboarding, payroll, employee relations, and compliance.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory benefits.
* Comfortable operating independently in a fast\-paced, start\-up\-style environment with limited process.
* Familiarity with an HRIS (Dayforce a plus) and solid, clear communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree; HR certification or MBA/PGDM a plus, not required.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Mission\-driven culture rooted in wellness and empowerment.
* A broad, hands\-on role where you own the work and see your impact.
* Global collaboration and real visibility as we grow in India.
* Hybrid flexibility and a people\-first environment.



  





**Honest Challenge**

 As the People Ops Lead for Coram AI's India office, you will be the on\-the\-ground person for all things people, office, and administration. You will own the full employee lifecycle in India, manage office administration and vendor relationships, ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, and create a workplace culture that reflects Coram's values. This role is ideal for someone who is resourceful, hands\-on, and thrives in ambiguity\-someone who can set up processes where none exist and keep a growing office running smoothly.
